description: Project metadata: the optional manifest `project` object (src/sync/project.ts validateDocsProjectMetadata; cli/src/sync_contract.cpp validate_project) and docs/stack.toml conversion (cli/src/sync_contract.cpp parse_stack_toml; C++ only, the server never reads TOML). Issues and warnings are compared by code and path, in order; paths name stack.toml keys. A successful result is the normalized wire object. Every `stackToml` result that is ok must also validate unchanged as a `cases` input.

cases.name: title and description are trimmed; description line endings become LF

project.title: Vaulthalla
project.description:
The Final Cloud.
Encrypted storage.Self-hosted.

project.description:

cases.name: arbitrary category names keep their order and item order
absent stack leaves the stack untouched (no stack key in the result)
multi-byte names up to 128 UTF-8 bytes
description keeps tabs and newlines inside
category without items is dropped with a warning
unknown fields are dropped with warnings (forward compatibility)
project must not be an array
category name must be a key (letters, digits, - and _)
category name must not start with - or _
category items must be an array
duplicate item in one category (ASCII case-insensitive, after trimming)
the same item in two categories is allowed
more than 64 items in a category
every issue is reported, in document order

dotted keys

stackToml.name: empty [stack] table clears without a warning
empty file clears the stack with a warning
project table only clears the stack with a warning
explicit empty category is dropped with a warning
unknown keys warn and are ignored
syntax error
duplicate key is a syntax error
project must be a table
stack must be a table
a category must be an array of tables
a single [stack.x] table is not an array of tables
an item must be a table
an item name must be a string
an item name is required
title must be a string
quoted category names must still be keys
duplicate category in different case
duplicate technology
